title: Glenn Gaffney named as a leader of the legacy program
place_text: CIA Directorate of Science and Technology

tellings.quote: a lot of people name Glenn Gaffne who's the director of science and technology there as being respon you know one of the last leaders of the legacy program.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that many people name Glenn Gaffney, who headed science and technology at the CIA, the American foreign spy agency, in the 2000s, as one of the last leaders of the legacy program. That is the name used for a long-running secret effort said to hold recovered craft of non-human origin. If true, it would place that effort inside the CIA's own research branch.
